Reviewer: an isolated contract reviewer at CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER, read-only on GitHub (REST reads only; nothing written, pushed or commented), fed the card body and comments, the PR body, the net diff against the merge-base, the head's check-runs, contract-review.md and review-checklist.md. The ruling itself, objectstack-ai/mobile#160 comment 6578710331, could not be read: `gh api repos/objectstack-ai/mobile/issues/comments/6578710331` and the issue read both answered HTTP 403 (repository not enabled for this session), so the ruling is judged against the card's verbatim quote 「非受管 PR 由席位落地」 plus 「我改了配置 Allow auto-merge」 and 「合并对立额已经开了」, and against the card's five terms and its measured platform table. The dev report was read as input, not as conclusions; every count below is this review's own measurement. No environment variable value is printed anywhere in this record.

### ① Derived judgments

The ruling as quoted, the card's five terms, the four extra in-place line changes and the PR's claims, one at a time:

1. File surface. One commit (8c094cf0, PR author `objectstack-fleet[bot]`, head repo = base repo, draft, base `main`); `git diff 5651647d82 8c094cf07d --stat`, the REST file listing and the PR body agree on exactly `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/mobile.md` (+5/−5, blob f9f8c2fa61). The claim (6584749813) fixed the surface to this one file, the 常设承诺 merge line replaced in place, ceiling 56 unchanged, stop on a need beyond 56. Measured: 56 lines before and after, five lines changed in place (7, 40, 41, 42, 44), no line added or removed, ceiling row `['.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/mobile.md', 56]` untouched, ratchet green. Widest changed line is 120 bytes (line 42; line 41 is 117, line 7 is 116), at the ratchet's documented 120-byte CJK wrap and not over it. Correct, and on surface.
2. The landing line (new line 41) against the ruling and terms 1 and 2. 「本席落地(裁决评论 6578710331)非受管、不改 `.github/workflows/**`、ACCEPT 且现 head 全绿的 PR。」 The ruling's words 「非受管 PR 由席位落地」 are the grant; the card's term 1 adds ACCEPT and green on the current head; term 2 removes governed-surface PRs and `.github/workflows/**` PRs. The line states the grant as a positive set with exactly those four conditions: not governed, not touching `.github/workflows/**`, ACCEPT, every check green on the current head. The mechanics the card names (mark ready, enable auto-merge, which enqueues) are carried by the verb: SKILL.md line 197 defines 「席位落地 = 过落地前检、清标、ready、auto-merge」 and landing-operations.md line 49 spells the relay ops `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable`; the charter's own line 47 says the framework is single-sourced in SKILL.md, so copying the four steps here would be the 不另抄 the file forbids. 「现 head 全绿」 is the entry rule of SKILL.md line 205 (每 check 绿或预期 skip, not the required subset) and contract-review.md line 51, so the line does not invent a weaker green. The workflows exclusion is explicit, which matters: `check-governed-merges.mjs` scopes its `workflows` row to `objectstack`, `objectui` and `cloud` and its header says mobile's workflows stay outside that row (as hotcrm's do, pinned by the `a-hotcrm-workflow-path-is-NOT-governed` case), so the register answers "not governed" for a mobile workflow path and this charter line is the only text keeping those PRs off the seat's landing; that is the card's 「even though the register does not list mobile's workflows」, stated. The ruling comment id in the line is provenance of the kind AGENTS.md asks a rule to carry (a ruling record, not an issue number or a date), with precedent at landing-operations.md line 62 「裁决评论 6104822731」; `check-skill-id-lint` (pattern `/#[0-9]{3,}/`) is clean. Correct, no more and no less than the ruling and terms 1 and 2, with one wording note carried to ③ and S1 (the maintainer is no longer named, see judgment 7).
3. Line 40 (release actions) against term 3 and the ruling. Before: 「三者皆按发布动作对待(AGENTS.md 发布条),⛔ 不由席位触发。」, 「三者」 being `eas-build.yml`, `eas-update.yml`, `eas-submit.yml` from line 39. After: 「`eas-submit.yml` 与版本切割按发布动作对待(AGENTS.md 发布条),⛔ 不由席位触发。」 Justified by the ruling, not only convenient: once the seat lands a PR to `main`, the push runs `eas-build.yml` and `eas-update.yml` (line 39, unchanged), so a charter that still said the seat never triggers them would contradict the ruling on every landing. Term 3 names exactly 「eas-submit.yml, store submission and version cuts」; line 39 (unchanged) already defines store submission as the manual trigger of `eas-submit.yml`, so the new line's two names cover the three words. The pre-ruling premise this replaces (all three workflows seat-forbidden) is also the premise the card's measured table disproves (every build and publish step `skipped`). Does dropping the blanket prohibition widen the seat's authority to, say, `workflow_dispatch` an EAS build? No: AGENTS.md Prime Directive 15 forbids every seat 「`workflow_dispatch`-ing `release.yml` … or any other publish-capable workflow」 and binds every lane 「not only in a lane-specific skill file」, and the new line 42 treats any build or publish step that actually ran as a stop condition, so the seat holds no authority over those runs beyond letting the queue's push fire them. The old line was a restatement of PD 15 for three workflows; the new line restates it for the two the card names. Correct, no widening, no dropped obligation.
4. Line 42 (the EAS guard) against term 4 and the measured table. Before: 「`EXPO_TOKEN` 是否配置席位读不到,恒按已配置。」 After: 「落地前读 `main` 最新 EAS Build/Update 运行:有 build/publish 步骤真跑即停落,升决策箱求新裁定。」 Term 4, term for term: before each landing (落地前), read the latest EAS Build and Update runs on `main` (读 `main` 最新 EAS Build/Update 运行), if any build or publish step actually ran (有 build/publish 步骤真跑), stop landing (即停落) and ask the maintainer for a new ruling (升决策箱求新裁定; the decision box is the one channel through which a seat asks the maintainer, SKILL.md lines 37 and 276, and 「拿不准升决策箱,⛔ 不自裁」 is this charter's own line 56). The old line's 「恒按已配置」 was the premise of the old conclusion: assuming the token set made every merge a release act and so forbade every seat landing; kept beside the new line 41 it would re-forbid what the ruling grants. The card's table measured the token unset and every step skipped; the guard reads the runs live instead of assuming either way, which is the stricter rule (it also catches the token being set later). The rationale the card attaches (token configured ⇒ a merge pushes OTA) is dropped, correctly: AGENTS.md says a rule carries no incident narrative. Correct, justified by term 4 and the table.
5. Line 44 (device checks) against term 5. 「⛔ 未上真机的项不报已验;落地不等于已上真机。」 appended in place to the unchanged rule; line 43 (需真机的验收项写进 PR `## 维护者速读` 的「需要你做的」) is untouched, so the first half of term 5 (device checks still go to the maintainer in 维护者速读) was already stated and the second half (landing is not device-verified) is now stated. Correct.
6. Line 7 (形态) against the ruling. Before: 「本席为姊妹仓执行座位:在 mobile 仓认领、派发、复核;落地窗口止于 ACCEPT 加交棒。」 After: 「本席为姊妹仓执行座位:mobile 仓认领、派发、复核,按落地条落地;余止于 ACCEPT 加交棒。」 The old second clause stated flatly that the seat's window ends at ACCEPT plus hand-off, which is the pre-ruling conclusion in other words and would have contradicted line 41 from the first line of the file; the card asked for the conclusion to be removed or rewritten 「accordingly」, and this clause was the conclusion's echo. The new clause grants landing only 「按落地条」 (line 41 is the one landing line in the file, so the reference resolves) and bounds every other PR at ACCEPT plus hand-off, which is where term 2's PRs go. The dropped 「在」 is a byte, not a term (116 bytes after). Justified, and it is the place the maintainer's half of the ruling now lives, see judgment 7.
7. 「No less」: is every obligation of the old block and of the card's terms still stated? The old line 42 said two things: the merge of every PR in this repo belongs to the maintainer (superseded by the ruling, correctly removed) and PRs touching `.github/workflows/**` 「同此,不因触发方式改变而解除」 (kept, as the explicit exclusion in line 41; the trigger-method clause was premise, and term 2's reason, the register not listing mobile's workflows, is why the exclusion has to be in this file at all). Term 2's own words are 「stay with the maintainer」. The new block never names the maintainer: governed-surface and workflows PRs are outside line 41's grant and fall under line 7's 「余止于 ACCEPT 加交棒」. The seat's obligation is intact (line 41 is the only grant and line 7 bounds the rest), and 交棒 in SKILL.md ③ (line 198, 「请审 = 席位交棒」) is the hand to the human approvers, so a reader of this skill lands at the maintainer. One tension remains for the reader who holds SKILL.md line 204 (Tier S = `.claude/**`, seat lands after a tier PASS) and line 199 (「Tier S 不交人」) beside this charter: a mobile `.claude/**` PR is governed, so by this charter it stops at ACCEPT and is handed off, which is what the card's term 2 says and what the old line 42 said in so many words, but 「交棒」 is the word SKILL.md reserves for Tier H. The old text resolved this with 「归维护者」; the new text leaves it to inference. No obligation is dropped, so this is not a must-fix; it is S1, one in-place word.
8. 「No more」: does the charter now grant anything the ruling and the card do not? Line 41 grants exactly the card's set; line 40 narrows a prohibition only as far as the ruling forces and PD 15 still binds the rest; line 42 adds a stop condition, never a grant; line 44 adds a prohibition; line 7 delegates to line 41. No new label, state, gate, workflow, CODEOWNERS row, register row or package. Nothing beyond the ruling.
9. Consistency with the rest of pm-dispatch. director.md line 39 「非受管 code PR 绿加 ACCEPT 即入队落地;受管面两层落地见 `../contract-review.md`」 is the same rule for the home repo; hotcrm.md line 7 and ui.md line 7 both list 落地 among the seat's acts; mobile.md now does too, with its two extra exclusions. SKILL.md 红线 lines 26 to 28 (never approve, merge or arm a governed PR without its tier's record; never bypass the queue) are untouched and not contradicted: line 41 lands only non-governed PRs, through 席位落地, which is the queue. `check-governed-merges.mjs --branch HEAD` on this PR answers GOVERNED Tier S (1 of 1 path under `.claude/**`, size 10), so this PR itself lands by the owning seat once this record is on the thread and every check is green, which is what the PR body's 「需要你做的:无,席位落地」 says.
10. Gates. `dispatch-gates --commands` over the path derives 17 commands (9 matched by path, 8 whole-tree). Run here in their `node` form (no `node_modules` in the throwaway worktree): check-skill-line-ratchet (default and self-test), check-skill-id-lint (default and self-test), check-nul-bytes (24242 text files, none), check-skill-frame-sync, check-agent-test-spelling, check-gitlink-declared, check-refd-timer-probe, check-watch-hint-literal, check-harness-current --self-test (26 cases), check-cross-package-test-inputs, plus the roster-flagged check-governed-prose and check-settings-deny-roster: all exit 0. Six answered PREREQUISITE NOT MET (exit 3) for the missing `yaml`, `typescript`, `@typescript-eslint/parser` or `node_modules` (check-governed-merges --self-test, check-closing-keyword-parity and its self-test, check-comment-mask-corpus, check-doc-authoring, check-driver-memory-census), and `check:doc-formula-expressions` needs a built `@objectstack/lint`, so it was not run; those are facts about this container, not the diff, and CI covers them: `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `Lint · docs & code guards`, `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Lint · CI, release & engine gates`, `Lint · ESLint` and `Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests` are all success on the head.
11. PR body against the head. 「第 7 行与第 40 至 44 行」 is right (the five changed lines); 56 lines, ceiling 56, row untouched (measured); 「new line 41, replaces the old line 42 conclusion」, 「line 40, replaces 三者皆按发布动作对待」, 「line 42, replaces EXPO_TOKEN…」 and 「line 44, appended in place」 all match the diff; 「No two lines were folded into one」 is true (five in-place edits, no line count change); 「no line of the file is over 120 bytes」 is true (max 120). `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` are right (no published schema, no authorable surface). `skip-changeset` is right (`.claude/**` publishes nothing; Check Changeset success). `Fixes #29429` is right: the card's Ask (state the ruling and the five terms, remove or rewrite the 「恒归维护者」 conclusion, no issue numbers in the operational text) is met in full, and the card names no second deliverable. The body's Verification list ran the `pnpm` forms with a `node_modules`; the subset reproducible here reproduces, and CI confirms the rest.
12. Independence and authorship. PR author `objectstack-fleet[bot]`, head repo = base repo; no off-relay author note is owed. The PR thread carries the seat's `Contract-review-claim:` for this head (6585118896) and no other record. Dev report: `premise_still_valid: true` (verified: the merge-base file still carries the old line 42), `open_questions` empty, `out_of_scope_findings` empty, `security_findings` none.

### ② Semver level

None. No published package, no `packages/spec/src/**`, no TypeScript; governed rules text only. `skip-changeset` is the right declaration and Check Changeset is success on the head.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev `open_questions`: none. Dev `out_of_scope_findings`: none. Dev `security_findings`: none.
- The ruling's source could not be read (HTTP 403 on objectstack-ai/mobile for this session); this record judges against the card's verbatim quote and five terms. The seat that lands this PR holds mobile access and can read comment 6578710331 in one call; if its words differ materially from the card's quote, that is a re-triage input, not a finding against this diff.
- The maintainer is no longer named in the block (judgment 7): the obligation holds by exclusion and by 交棒, but SKILL.md reserves 交棒 for Tier H while this charter (per the card's term 2 and the old line 42) keeps even Tier S `.claude/**` PRs with the maintainer. S1 below.
- Line 40 narrows a restatement of AGENTS.md Prime Directive 15 from three EAS workflows to the two names the card gives; PD 15 itself still binds every seat for any publish-capable workflow, so no gap opens. Noted, no fix.
- Independence: `Implemented-by:` and `Reviewed-by:` differ; the review ran in an isolated subagent at tier.

### ④ Design judgment

Per hits file, against the card's scenario (the maintainer has turned on auto-merge and the queue on mobile `main` and ruled that the seat lands non-governed PRs; the charter must say so without widening the seat past the ruling):

- `lanes/mobile.md`: stating the grant as one positive line with its four conditions, and letting the defined term 席位落地 carry the mechanics, is the right cut for a 56-line charter at its ceiling that already points at SKILL.md as the single source. Rewriting the three premise lines (40 to 42) rather than appending a ruling line beside them is the right call too: each old line was a premise of the old conclusion, and a charter that kept 「三者…不由席位触发」 or 「恒按已配置」 beside a landing grant would contradict itself on the first landing. The guard reads the live runs rather than the token, which is the stricter and the measurable form. Folding the maintainer's half into line 41's exclusions plus line 7's remainder clause keeps the file at 56 without a ruled raise and does not drop the obligation, at the cost of one lost word (维护者) that a 119-byte rewording of line 7 restores. Holds.

Must-fix: none.

- S1 (one in-place word, line 7; fits at 119 bytes, 56 lines unchanged; a delta head on this PR by the same dev, or a follow-up card at the seat's choice): name the maintainer once so term 2's 「stay with the maintainer」 is stated rather than inferred and the Tier S 「不交人」 tension does not reach the reader, for example 「…按落地条落地;余止于 ACCEPT,归维护者。」 (measured 119 bytes).
